NavalToolbox - https://github.com/NavalToolbox/navaltoolbox-lib (AGPL-3.0; Rust library with Python bindings).
The library is installed as the `navaltoolbox` package from PyPI (pip install navaltoolbox; version 0.9.3 tested): its compiled code is not copied here. The stability-criteria scripts
(rules/*.rhai: IS Code 2008 general / passenger / complete, HSC 2000, DIV 222, template) are copied unchanged and run by its ScriptEngine. ShipBrain's own wrapper is shipbrain/navalbridge.py.
